core_obligations: Construction (proof lines 5977-5996): after the countable-direct-sum case is dismissed by the preceding discussion, the author forms the object A of the graded category with F^{p+1}K in degree p, endows it with the differential induced by d, observes that the inclusion alpha : (A, d) -> (A, d)[-1] is an injective morphism of differential objects, and applies the abstract self-map construction with S the identity and T = [1].
Bidegrees (proof lines 5997-6000): since T^r S = [r], the differential of the resulting spectral sequence satisfies d_r : E_r -> E_r[r], that is d_r^p : E_r^p -> E_r^{p+r}, as claimed.

The first two pages (proof lines 6002-6011): E_0 is computed as the cokernel of alpha, which gives E_0^p = gr^p K and d_0^p = gr^p d, and the descriptions of the boundaries and cocycles given by the self-map remark translate into the formulae for E_1^p = H(gr^p K, gr^p d).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the countable direct sum case when it applies.
Build the graded differential object whose inclusion is injective and apply the self-map construction with shift [1].
Read off the bidegree of the differentials and identify the first two pages.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the spectral sequence of a filtered differential object, in the graded category, with differentials d_r : E_r -> E_r[r] and first pages the associated graded and its cohomology (statement lines 5965-5975). The proof is a complete argument: the countable-direct-sum case comes from the preceding discussion; in general the author constructs a graded differential object out of the filtration steps, proves the natural inclusion is an injective morphism of differential objects, applies the abstract construction with the shift [1] (proof lines 5977-6000), and unwinds the definitions to identify E_0 and E_1 (proof lines 6002-6011). The non-formal content is the choice of the graded object and the unwinding. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
